info.name: Request a signed URL to start an FTTx engineering job.

items.docs: Submits a new engineering job identifier. The response is a signed URL for the Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket. The input data for the engineering job needs to be uploaded to the received the signed URL location. See **/s3url_uploads** endpoint.

info.name: Submit the input for the engineering job.

params.name: jsonFileNameAndExtension
params.description:
The **jobId** of the engineering job you defined in **/startJobS3** or **/jobResultS3** with added .json extension.  </br>
Pattern: `^.+\.(json)$` </br>
Example: `FTTx_AdamNorth_Input_Dec2020.json`

params.name: X-Amz-Algorithm
params.description: Identifies the version of AWS Signature and the algorithm used to calculate the signature. Use the value provided as part of the signed URL response of **/startJobS3** or **/jobResultS3**. </br> Example: `AWS4-HMAC-SHA256`

params.name: X-Amz-Credential
params.description: This parameter provides scope (AWS region and service) for which the signature is valid. Use the value provided as part of the signed URL response of **/startJobS3** or **/jobResultS3**. </br> Example: `AAAAAA%2F20201201%2Feu-west-1%2Fs3%2Faws4_request`

params.name: X-Amz-Date
params.description:
The date when the signedUrl was generated. Use the value provided as part of the signed URL response of **/startJobS3** or **/jobResultS3**.     </br>
    Example: `20201201T120000Z`

params.name: X-Amz-Expires
params.description:
Provides the time period, in seconds, for which the generated presigned URL is valid. Use the value provided as part of the signed URL response of **/startJobS3** or **/jobResultS3**. </br>
    Example: `3600`

params.name: X-Amz-SignedHeaders
params.description:
Lists the headers used to calculate the signature. Use the value provided as part of the signed URL response of **/startJobS3** or **/jobResultS**. </br>
    Example: `host`

params.name: X-Amz-Security-Token
params.description:
Additional credential parameter. Use the value provided as part of the signed URL response of **/startJobS3** or **/jobResultS3**. </br>
Example: `AAAAAAAAAAluX2VjEA0aCWV1LXdlc3QtMSJIMEYCIQDKnFBi14jhVzfJHKod%2FCpwTIFkAj3kttgcdNRSngk49gIhAK6DboCvbtAmjlWDG5pBgzaFV1lXC0yFZWelULkpV%2FNVKuUBCNb%2F%2F%2F%2F%2F%2F%2F%2F%2F%2FwEQABoMNjUyNDM0MTA2NTI4Igwfybzhyrjg3aq7hbMquQHE00Xe9PiL%2BS%2BSlhrzrpOKg2y%2F5qfjbR2BrGcPpxta3EiBwUpvmXR%2F%2BqkQBG7BuJifYKaDkdnOS%2B3OzxkV2WRHnKnlNwann1vCLTS9AWGdNRFLE72iJ2s%2BT3lwQp%2BR6bGMjcfqEDm84MR3gINTpSp84y9bt9hoxtxfXzF8SfGv5LVoN45K8Rf%2B%2BqF7%2BwF03JWV50Klauq4hneHRiyWsUgQY6pFMN14xj83Jn5fxKJi0L7qh%2BWBfMnDCTCW1%2Fv%2FBTrfAbwZuNzIkBmhmHsmDO9hS2dLEfqpH9GpPUl8YLY3vfjATqpjnz241WrrBdyTawUFbiTEbcKx05dUwbkUdLRP2i9CZVLAl%2Bqk0J6VYmIEhhU2RS54oHCZzinEVzsdo%2BS5eXRQ9BiAD8OCH2gP3a7bXDx9HOBxSdbGMv5mXMeP1wsdjC7e%2FkVsQlEtBTNgc62EiloUbQlPiQyb1OQEMMGZd%2BV5N%2FxdNq%2For1UraAbvxAAzGHUqQff4rmZCEDbO5uv2kwWDR1boarpQeEG8Q3j%2BxSNde%2FG%2BUjg425uIAAAAAAAAAA`

params.name: X-Amz-Signature
params.description:
The signature to authenticate your request. Use the value provided as part of the signed URL response of **/startJobS3** or **/jobResultS3**.
  </br>
Example: `aaaaaaaaaa09c013193ffd301019b60308a092c972b22fdfcb8424bbbbbbbbbb`

items.docs: Uploads the data of the new engineering job for calculation. Use the signed URL received from **/startJobS3** for this. In the request body you need to specify an area for engineering. When the input has been submitted, this is detected and the calculation will start.

info.name: Returns the current status of the calculation job identified by jobId

items.docs: This method is called by the HLD front-end to get the current status of a job

info.name: Returns a signed URL where the results of an engineering job can be retrieved.

items.docs: When an engineering job is finished. This endpoint should be called first to retrieve a signed URL for the Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket where the results are stored. More details on how to use this URL to retrieve the results are specified in the /Output endpoint.
